subtasks: Observe the object placement order and remember it. Keep both of your arms at their starting poses until the demonstrating arm has fully returned to its starting pose; placing the last object does not mean the demonstration is finished. Only then place the corresponding objects into the basket in the same order. Finally, return both of your arms to their starting poses.
Place the green wristwatch on the front table into the white basket on the left.
Place the black rectangular object from the front center of the table into the white basket on the left.
Place the purple keypad phone from the front of the table into the white basket on the left.
Place the cream-colored doll wearing blue from the front right of the table into the white basket on the left.
Pick up the small turquoise toy car from the front table and place it in the white basket on the left.
Return both open arms to their initial starting poses.
